TESTNING BALLARI: 10+10+8+8+7+12+4+2+4+20+15 = 100 ball (bet ostida 'TOTAL: 100 marks' deb yozilgan). Ba'zi mashqlarda bo'sh joylar soni ball sonidan ko'p (masalan 5-mashqda 21 katak = 7 ball, 3-mashqda 10 bo'sh joy = 8 ball, 9-mashqda 5 bo'sh joy = 4 ball) — bu XATO emas, balki ataylab og'irlik berilgan baholash.

10-mashqning 8 va 15-bandlarida qavsda 'go' berilgan, lekin Unit 15 qoidasiga ko'ra to'g'ri javob 'have also BEEN' va 'haven't BEEN' bo'ladi (Ann Harrods'dan qaytgan, hali u yerda emas). Ikkala shakl ham izohda ko'rsatilgan.

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  for
  2  ago
  3  never
  4  yet ... just


TO'LIQ GAPLAR:

 1  'I haven't been windsurfing FOR a month.'
    (Bir oydan beri vindserfing qilmadim.)

 2  'We went on a boat trip two weeks AGO.'
    (Ikki hafta oldin qayiq sayohatiga
     chiqdik.)

 3  'Maria has NEVER played football.'
    (Mariya hech qachon futbol o'ynamagan.)

 4  A: 'Has Peter washed the car YET?'
    B: 'Yes, he has. He's JUST finished.'
    (A: Piter mashinani yuvdimi?
     B: Ha. U hozirgina tugatdi.)


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  FOR ↔ SINCE:
       FOR + DAVOMIYLIK (qancha vaqt)
          for a month, for 3 years, for ages
       SINCE + NUQTA (qachondan)
          since 1989, since Monday, since May

    'a month' — davomiylik → FOR

 2  AGO ↔ LAST:
       AGO — o'lchov + 'ago', GAP OXIRIDA
          two weeks AGO, a year AGO
       LAST — otdan OLDIN
          LAST week, LAST year

    'two weeks ...' → AGO
    ('two weeks last' — mumkin emas)

    ⚠ 'ago' — DOIM Past Simple bilan!

 3  NEVER ↔ EVER:
       NEVER — inkor ma'no, TASDIQ shaklda
          'She has NEVER played.'
       EVER — faqat SAVOLDA
          'Have you EVER played?'

    Bu gap SAVOL emas → NEVER

 4  YET ↔ JUST:
       YET — SAVOL va INKORDA, gap OXIRIDA
          'Has he finished YET?'
          'He hasn't finished YET.'
       JUST — TASDIQDA, have/has bilan fe'l
          ORASIDA
          'He has JUST finished.'

    Birinchi gap SAVOL → YET
    Ikkinchi gap TASDIQ → JUST


⚠ 4-BAND — O'RIN JOYLAShUVI:

  YET — gap OXIRIDA:
     'Has Peter washed the car YET?'

  JUST — HAVE/HAS va V3 ORASIDA:
     'He HAS JUST FINISHED.'
     ('He has finished just' ✗)


UNIT 15 QOIDALARINING TAKRORI:
  for / since  — Grammar 66-bet
  ever / never — Grammar 66-bet
  just / yet / already — Grammar 65-bet


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  windsurfing = vindserfing
  a boat trip = qayiq sayohati
  to wash     = yuvmoq
  to finish   = tugatmoq

items.textEn: 1  I haven't been windsurfing since/for a month.
items.whyUz:
'a month' — DAVOMIYLIK (qancha vaqt) → FOR.

  FOR + davomiylik: for a month, for 3 years
  SINCE + nuqta: since May, since 1989

Agar 'since May' bo'lsa — SINCE bo'lardi.

items.textEn: 2  We went on a boat trip two weeks last/ago.
items.uz: Ikki hafta oldin qayiq sayohatiga chiqdik.
items.whyUz:
⚠ O'RIN FARQI:
  AGO — o'lchovdan KEYIN: 'two weeks AGO'
  LAST — otdan OLDIN: 'LAST week'

'two weeks last' — mumkin emas.

'ago' DOIM Past Simple bilan ('went' ✓).

Bu gap TASDIQ shaklda, SAVOL emas → NEVER.

  NEVER — inkor ma'no, tasdiq shaklda
  EVER — faqat SAVOLDA
     'Have you EVER played football?'

⚠ 'has never' — ikki inkor BO'LMAYDI
(114-bet, 6-mashq, 7-band).

items.textEn: 4  A: Has Peter washed the car yet/just?   (birinchi bo'sh joy)
items.whyUz:
Bu — SAVOL → YET.

  YET — savol va inkorda, GAP OXIRIDA
  JUST — tasdiqda, have/has va V3 ORASIDA

'Has he finished YET?' ✓

items.textEn: 4  B: Yes, he has. He's just/yet finished.   (ikkinchi bo'sh joy)
items.whyUz:
Bu — TASDIQ → JUST.

⚠ O'RNI: HAVE/HAS va V3 ORASIDA:
  'He HAS JUST FINISHED.'  ✓
  'He has finished just.'  ✗

'He's' bu yerda 'he HAS' (keyin V3 bor).

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the dialogue with the questions below. (2 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni quyidagi savollar bilan to'ldiring. (2 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOLLAR:
  • Would you like to go?
  • What are you doing tonight?


JAVOBLAR:
  1  What are you doing tonight?
  2  Would you like to go?


TO'LIQ DIALOG:

  A: 'Hello, Helen. WHAT ARE YOU DOING
      TONIGHT?'
  B: 'I haven't got any plans. Why?'
  A: 'Well, there's a great concert on at the
      Royal Palace tonight. WOULD YOU LIKE TO
      GO?'
  B: 'Yes — that would be great!'
  A: 'Okay. I'll pick you up at seven, then.'


TARJIMASI:
  A: 'Salom, Helen. Bugun kechqurun nima
      qilyapsan?'
  B: 'Hech qanday rejam yo'q. Nima edi?'
  A: 'Bugun kechqurun Royal Palace'da ajoyib
      konsert bor. Borishni xohlaysanmi?'
  B: 'Ha — zo'r bo'lardi!'
  A: 'Yaxshi. Unda soat yettida olib
      ketaman.'


MANTIQ — QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

 1  Javob: 'I haven't got any PLANS.'
    → Savol REJA haqida bo'lishi kerak.
    → 'What are you doing tonight?'

    ⚠ 'Would you like to go?' bu yerda XATO —
    hali qayerga borish aytilmagan!

 2  Oldin: 'there's a great CONCERT on'
    Keyin: 'Yes — that would be great!'
    → Savol TAKLIF bo'lishi kerak.
    → 'Would you like to go?'


⚠ 'WHAT ARE YOU DOING TONIGHT?' —
KELAJAK MA'NOSIDA:

  Present Continuous — REJALAShTIRILGAN
  kelajak uchun ham ishlatiladi.

     'What are you doing tonight?'
     = Bugun kechqurun nima qilyapsan?
       (rejang nima?)

  Unit 13 — kelajak shakllari.


⚠ 'WOULD YOU LIKE TO ...?' — MUShTARAK
TAKLIF ShAKLI:

  'Would you like to go?' = Borishni
  xohlaysanmi? (muloyim taklif)

  Javoblari:
     'Yes, I'd love to.'
     'That would be great!'
     'I'm afraid I can't.'

  Boshqa taklif shakllari:
     'How about going?'
     'Why don't we go?'
     'Let's go!'


DIQQAT — 'THERE'S A CONCERT ON':
  'there's ... ON' = ... bo'lyapti,
  o'tkazilyapti

  'What's on tonight?' = Bugun nima bor?


DIQQAT — 'PICK SOMEBODY UP':
  'I'll PICK YOU UP at seven.'
  = seni soat yettida olib ketaman
  (mashinada borib olmoq)

  Ajraladigan fe'l:
     pick you up   ✓
     pick up you   ✗


DIQQAT — 'I'LL':
  'I'LL pick you up' — o'sha zahoti qabul
  qilingan qaror → WILL (Unit 13).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  plans        = rejalar
  a concert    = konsert
  there's ... on = ... bo'lyapti
  Would you like to ...? = ... ni
                 xohlaysizmi?
  That would be great! = Zo'r bo'lardi!
  to pick somebody up = borib olmoq

exercises.instructionEn: Use the verbs below to fill in the gaps. (4 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi fe'llardan bo'sh joylarni to'ldiring. (4 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (4 ta):
  can, can't, should, mustn't


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  should
  2  can
  3  can
  4  can't
  5  mustn't


⚠ 5 TA BO'Sh JOY, 4 TA FE'L!
  'CAN' IKKI MARTA ishlatiladi (2 va 3).

  Kitob '(4 marks)' deb yozgan — bu
  og'irlikli baholash, xato emas.


TO'LIQ DIALOGLAR:

  1-dialog:
     A: 'I have got the flu.'
     B: 'You SHOULD see a doctor.'

     (A: Grippim bor.
      B: Shifokorga ko'rinishing kerak.)

  2-dialog:
     A: 'Mum, CAN I have a glass of milk,
         please?'
     B: 'Yes, of course you CAN.'

     (A: Oyi, bir stakan sut ichsam
         bo'ladimi?
      B: Ha, albatta, bo'ladi.)

  3-dialog:
     A: 'Can I feed the animals?'
     B: 'No, you CAN'T. You MUSTN'T feed the
         animals — it's forbidden.'

     (A: Hayvonlarni boqsam bo'ladimi?
      B: Yo'q, bo'lmaydi. Hayvonlarni
         boqmaslik kerak — bu taqiqlangan.)


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'I have got THE FLU.' → kasal.
    Kasal odamga MASLAHAT → SHOULD.
    'You should see a doctor.'

    ⚠ 'must' emas — bu do'stona maslahat,
    qonun emas.

 2  'Mum, ......... I have ..., PLEASE?'
    RUXSAT SO'RASh → CAN.
    'please' — iltimosni ko'rsatadi.

    (114-bet, 6-mashq, 11-band: 'Must I have
     an ice-cream?' XATO edi — aynan shu
     qoida!)

 3  'Yes, of course you .........'
    RUXSAT BERISh → CAN.
    Savoldagi fe'l takrorlanadi.

 4  'No, you .........'
    RUXSAT BERMASLIK → CAN'T.
    Savol 'Can I ...?' edi → javob 'you
    CAN'T'.

 5  'You ......... feed the animals — IT'S
     FORBIDDEN.'
    KALIT: 'FORBIDDEN' (taqiqlangan)
    → MUSTN'T (qat'iy taqiq).


⚠ 4 va 5-BANDLAR FARQI:

  CAN'T — 'ruxsat yo'q' (javob)
  MUSTN'T — 'TAQIQLANGAN' (qoida, qonun)

  Ikkalasi ham inkor, lekin MUSTN'T
  KUCHLIROQ.

  Shuning uchun kitob avval 'can't', keyin
  sababini 'mustn't' bilan aytadi.


TO'RT FE'LNING UMUMIY JADVALI:

  CAN     = mumkin (ruxsat, qobiliyat)
  CAN'T   = mumkin emas
  SHOULD  = kerak (MASLAHAT)
  MUSTN'T = TAQIQLANGAN (qat'iy)

  ⚠ Hammasidan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
     'you should SEE'  ✓
     'you should TO see' ✗

  ⚠ 3-shaxsda '-S' QO'ShILMAYDI:
     'he can'  ✓   'he cans'  ✗
     'he should' ✓ 'he shoulds' ✗


DIQQAT — 'TO SEE A DOCTOR':
  'see a doctor' = shifokorga ko'rinmoq
  (shifokorni 'ko'rish' emas!)


DIQQAT — 'THE FLU':
  'I've got THE flu' — artikl 'the' bilan.
  'a headache' — artikl 'a' bilan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  the flu      = gripp
  to see a doctor = shifokorga ko'rinmoq
  a glass of milk = bir stakan sut
  of course    = albatta
  to feed      = boqmoq
  forbidden    = taqiqlangan

items.sentence: A: I have got the flu.   B: You 1) ......................... see a doctor.
items.uz: A: Grippim bor. B: Shifokorga ko'rinishing kerak.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'THE FLU' — kasal odam.
Kasal odamga MASLAHAT → SHOULD.

'must' emas — bu do'stona maslahat, qonun
emas.

Keyin ASOSIY shakl: 'should SEE' ('should to
see' XATO).

items.sentence: A: Mum, 2) ......................... I have a glass of milk, please?
items.uz: A: Oyi, bir stakan sut ichsam bo'ladimi?

commonMistake.whyUz:
RUXSAT SO'RASH → CAN.
'PLEASE' iltimosni ko'rsatadi.

⚠ 114-bet, 6-mashqning 11-bandi aynan shu
xato edi: 'MUST I have an ice-cream?' —
'Must I ...?' = 'Majburmanmi?'

RUXSAT BERISH → CAN.
Savoldagi fe'l ('Can I ...?') javobda
takrorlanadi.

⚠ 'can' bu mashqda IKKI MARTA ishlatiladi
(2 va 3-bandlar) — ro'yxatda 4 ta so'z,
bo'sh joy 5 ta.

items.sentence: A: Can I feed the animals?   B: No, you 4) ......................... .
items.uz: A: Hayvonlarni boqsam bo'ladimi? B: Yo'q, bo'lmaydi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
RUXSAT BERMASLIK → CAN'T.

Savol 'CAN I ...?' → javob 'you CAN'T'.
Qisqa javobda fe'l takrorlanadi.

items.sentence: B: You 5) ......................... feed the animals — it's forbidden.
items.uz: B: Hayvonlarni boqmaslik kerak — bu taqiqlangan.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'IT'S FORBIDDEN' (taqiqlangan)
→ MUSTN'T.

⚠ CAN'T va MUSTN'T FARQI:
  CAN'T = ruxsat yo'q (javob)
  MUSTN'T = TAQIQLANGAN (qoida) — KUCHLIROQ

Kitob avval 'can't', keyin sababini
'mustn't' bilan aytadi.

exercises.instructionEn: First put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense.
exercises.instructionUz: Avval qavs ichidagi fe'llarni to'g'ri zamonga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
ANNNING SEM'GA YOZGAN XATI (Londondan).


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  is
   2  am having
   3  am staying
   4  lives
   5  have already visited
   6  visited
   7  bought
   8  have also been
   9  took
  10  didn't buy
  11  have eaten
  12  went
  13  had
  14  haven't done
  15  haven't been
  16  are going
  17  am returning
  18  will call


TO'LIQ XAT (javoblar bilan):

  'Dear Sam,
   Greetings from London! The weather IS warm
   and sunny and I AM HAVING a wonderful
   time. I AM STAYING with my Uncle Douglas.
   He LIVES in the city centre.

   I HAVE ALREADY VISITED Buckingham Palace.
   We VISITED it on Friday. I BOUGHT some
   postcards there. I HAVE ALSO BEEN to
   Harrods. My uncle TOOK me there yesterday,
   but I DIDN'T BUY anything. I HAVE EATEN at
   an Indian restaurant too! We WENT there
   last night and I HAD a very hot curry!

   There are a lot of things I HAVEN'T DONE
   yet. I HAVEN'T BEEN to Covent Garden or
   Piccadilly Circus yet. We ARE GOING to
   Hyde Park tomorrow.

   London is a fascinating city — you must
   visit it one day! Anyway, I AM RETURNING
   home on 15th June, so I WILL CALL you
   then.
   Best wishes,
   Ann'


ZAMONLAR BO'YIChA:

  PRESENT SIMPLE — 1, 4
     doimiy holat / hozirgi holat

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS — 2, 3, 16, 17
     vaqtinchalik holat va
     rejalashtirilgan kelajak

  PRESENT PERFECT — 5, 8, 11, 14, 15
     vaqt AYTILMAGAN; already/yet bilan

  PAST SIMPLE — 6, 7, 9, 10, 12, 13
     ANIQ VAQT bor (on Friday, yesterday,
     last night)

  WILL — 18
     va'da


⚠ ENG MUHIM NAMUNA — PRESENT PERFECT keyin
PAST SIMPLE:

  Ann avval NATIJANI aytadi (vaqtsiz),
  keyin TAFSILOTNI (vaqt bilan):

     'I HAVE ALREADY VISITED Buckingham
      Palace.'  (vaqt yo'q → Present Perfect)
     'We VISITED it ON FRIDAY.'
        (aniq vaqt → Past Simple)

     'I HAVE ALSO BEEN to Harrods.'
        (vaqt yo'q)
     'My uncle TOOK me there YESTERDAY.'
        (aniq vaqt)

     'I HAVE EATEN at an Indian restaurant.'
        (vaqt yo'q)
     'We WENT there LAST NIGHT.'
        (aniq vaqt)

  Bu — Unit 15 ning ASOSIY namunasi!


⚠ 8 va 15-BANDLAR — 'BEEN' yoki 'GONE'?

  Qavsda 'go' berilgan, lekin to'g'ri javob
  'BEEN':

     'I have BEEN to Harrods.'
     = borib KELDIM (hozir u yerda emasman)

     'I have GONE to Harrods.'
     = ketdim, HALI U YERDAMAN

  Ann amakisining uyidan xat yozyapti,
  demak Harrods'dan QAYTGAN → BEEN.

  15-band ham shunday:
     'I HAVEN'T BEEN to Covent Garden yet.'
     = hali bormadim

  Grammar 65-bet, Workbook 61-bet — been/gone
  qoidasi.


⚠ 3-BAND va 4-BAND FARQI:

  'I AM STAYING with my uncle.'
     → VAQTINCHALIK (Present Continuous)

  'He LIVES in the city centre.'
     → DOIMIY (Present Simple)

  Ann bir necha kunga kelgan — vaqtinchalik.
  Amakisi doim u yerda yashaydi.


⚠ 16 va 17-BANDLAR — KELAJAK:

  'We ARE GOING to Hyde Park TOMORROW.'
  'I AM RETURNING home ON 15TH JUNE.'

  Present Continuous — REJALAShTIRILGAN,
  ANIQ vaqt belgilangan kelajak (Unit 13).

  ⚠ 18-band boshqacha:
     'I WILL CALL you then.'
     → VA'DA (o'sha zahoti qabul qilingan
       qaror) → WILL


⚠ 14-BAND — 'YET':
  'a lot of things I HAVEN'T DONE YET'
  'yet' — INKORDA, gap oxirida
  → Present Perfect

  do → did → DONE


DIQQAT — 'GREETINGS FROM ...':
  'Greetings from London!' = Londondan salom!
  Otkritka va xatlarda turg'un ibora.


DIQQAT — 'A HOT CURRY':
  'hot' bu yerda = AChChIQ (issiq emas!)
  'a very hot curry' = juda achchiq karri


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  greetings   = salomlar
  to stay with = ... nikida turmoq
  a postcard  = otkritka
  Harrods     = Londondagi mashhur do'kon
  curry       = karri (hind taomi)
  hot         = achchiq (taom haqida)
  Covent Garden / Piccadilly Circus / Hyde Park
              = Londondagi mashhur joylar
  fascinating = maftunkor
  Anyway      = xullas
  to return   = qaytmoq

items.sentence: 1  Greetings from London! The weather ................... (be) warm and sunny
items.uz: Londondan salom! Havo iliq va quyoshli

commonMistake.whyUz:
HOZIRGI holat → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'The weather' — BIRLIK → IS.

AYNI PAYTDA davom etayotgan holat
→ PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

⚠ 'have a good time' ma'nosida 'have'
Continuous BO'LADI (chunki bu HARAKAT).
Egalik ma'nosidagi 'have' esa Continuous
bo'lmaydi ('I am having a car' XATO).

⚠ VAQTINCHALIK holat → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

Ann bir necha kunga kelgan.

4-band bilan solishtiring: amakisi DOIM
u yerda yashaydi → Present Simple.

⚠ DOIMIY holat → PRESENT SIMPLE.

'He' — 3-shaxs birlik → '-S' qo'shiladi:
LIVES.

3-band bilan farqi: 'am staying'
(vaqtinchalik) ↔ 'lives' (doimiy).

KALIT: 'ALREADY' → PRESENT PERFECT.

⚠ O'RNI: HAVE va V3 ORASIDA:
'have ALREADY visited' ✓

Vaqt aytilmagan — natija muhim (Unit 15).

KALIT: 'ON FRIDAY' — ANIQ VAQT
→ PAST SIMPLE.

⚠ ASOSIY NAMUNA: 5-band Present Perfect
(vaqtsiz), 6-band Past Simple (vaqt bilan).

6-band bilan bir xil vaqtda (juma kuni)
→ PAST SIMPLE.

buy → BOUGHT → bought (noto'g'ri fe'l,
114-bet 5-mashq jadvalida bor).

⚠ 'BEEN' yoki 'GONE'?

Qavsda 'go' berilgan, lekin to'g'ri javob
'have also BEEN':
  have BEEN = borib KELDI (hozir u yerda emas)
  have GONE = ketdi, HALI u yerda

Ann amakisining uyidan yozyapti → BEEN.

Vaqt aytilmagan → Present Perfect.
'ALSO' — have va V3 orasida.

items.uz: Amakim meni kecha u yerga olib bordi,

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'YESTERDAY' — ANIQ VAQT
→ PAST SIMPLE.

take → TOOK → taken (noto'g'ri fe'l).

8-band (vaqtsiz) → 9-band (vaqt bilan) —
yana o'sha namuna.

items.uz: lekin men hech narsa sotib olmadim.

commonMistake.whyUz:
9-band bilan bir xil vaqtda (kecha)
→ PAST SIMPLE INKOR.

⚠ 'DIDN'T' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
  'didn't BUY'    ✓
  'didn't BOUGHT' ✗

'anything' — inkorda ('something' emas).

items.sentence: 11  I ................................... (eat) at an Indian restaurant too!

commonMistake.whyUz:
Vaqt AYTILMAGAN, TAJRIBA
→ PRESENT PERFECT.

eat → ate → EATEN (noto'g'ri fe'l).

'TOO' (ham) — yangi tajriba qo'shilyapti.

KALIT: 'LAST NIGHT' — ANIQ VAQT
→ PAST SIMPLE.

go → WENT → gone.

11-band (vaqtsiz) → 12-band (vaqt bilan) —
uchinchi marta o'sha namuna!

items.sentence: 13  and I ....................... (have) a very hot curry!

commonMistake.whyUz:
12-band bilan bir xil vaqtda
→ PAST SIMPLE.

have → HAD → had.

⚠ 'HOT' bu yerda = ACHCHIQ (issiq emas!).
'have a curry' = karri yemoq.

items.sentence: 14  There are a lot of things I ................................... (not/do) yet.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'YET' → PRESENT PERFECT INKOR.

'yet' — inkor va savolda, GAP OXIRIDA.

do → did → DONE (noto'g'ri fe'l,
114-bet 5-mashq jadvalida bor).

items.sentence: 15  I ................................... (not/go) to Covent Garden or Piccadilly Circus yet.
items.uz: Hali Kovent Garden yoki Pikkadilli Sirkusga bormadim.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'YET' → PRESENT PERFECT INKOR.

⚠ Yana 'BEEN': 'haven't BEEN to a place'
= hali bormadim.

'haven't gone' — bu yerda noto'g'ri
(u hech qayerga ketmagan).

Grammar 65-bet — been/gone qoidasi.

KALIT: 'TOMORROW' + REJA
→ PRESENT CONTINUOUS (kelajak ma'nosida).

Unit 13: rejalashtirilgan, aniq vaqt
belgilangan kelajak → am/is/are + V-ing.

('are going to go' ham mumkin.)

KALIT: 'ON 15TH JUNE' — ANIQ sana +
REJALASHTIRILGAN → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

16-band bilan bir xil qoida.

Chiptalar olingan, sana belgilangan.

items.uz: shuning uchun o'shanda senga qo'ng'iroq qilaman.

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ 16-17-bandlardan FARQLI!

Bu — VA'DA, o'sha zahoti qabul qilingan
qaror → WILL.

Hali qo'ng'iroq REJALASHTIRILMAGAN
(vaqti, aniq soati yo'q).

Unit 13: WILL — va'da, bashorat, o'sha
zahotgi qaror.

exercises.explanationUz:
YETTI GAPNING HAMMASI NOTO'G'RI —
HAMMASINI TUZATISh KERAK.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  ✗ 'The weather in London is RAINY.'
    ✓ 'The weather in London is WARM AND
       SUNNY.'
    Dalil: 'The weather is WARM AND SUNNY.'

 2  ✗ 'Ann is having a TERRIBLE time.'
    ✓ 'Ann is having a WONDERFUL time.'
    Dalil: 'I am having A WONDERFUL TIME.'

 3  ✗ 'Ann HASN'T VISITED Buckingham Palace
       YET.'
    ✓ 'Ann HAS ALREADY VISITED Buckingham
       Palace. She visited it ON FRIDAY.'
    Dalil: 'I have ALREADY visited Buckingham
    Palace. We visited it on Friday.'

 4  ✗ 'Ann BOUGHT LOTS OF THINGS in Harrods.'
    ✓ 'Ann DIDN'T BUY ANYTHING in Harrods.'
    Dalil: 'but I didn't buy anything.'

 5  ✗ 'Ann's uncle took her to A TRADITIONAL
       RESTAURANT.'
    ✓ 'Ann's uncle took her to HARRODS. She
       went to AN INDIAN RESTAURANT with
       somebody else ("we"), not with her
       uncle.'
    Dalil: 'My uncle took me THERE
    [= to Harrods] yesterday.'

 6  ✗ 'Ann and her uncle are going to COVENT
       GARDEN tomorrow.'
    ✓ 'Ann and her uncle are going to HYDE
       PARK tomorrow. She hasn't been to
       Covent Garden YET.'
    Dalil: 'We are going to HYDE PARK
    tomorrow.'

 7  ✗ 'Ann is returning home on 20TH AUGUST.'
    ✓ 'Ann is returning home on 15TH JUNE.'
    Dalil: 'I am returning home on 15TH
    JUNE.'


⚠ 3-BAND — ENG NOZIK:

  Gap 'HASN'T ... YET' deydi, lekin xatda
  'ALREADY' bor — bu ikkalasi ZID!

     'hasn't ... YET' = hali qilmagan
     'has ALREADY ...' = allaqachon qilgan

  Tuzatishda 'yet' ni 'already' ga
  almashtirish kerak.


⚠ 5-BAND — ENG PUXTA O'QISh KERAK:

  Xatda IKKI JOY bor:
     a) Harrods — AMAKISI olib borgan
        ('MY UNCLE took me THERE')
     b) Hind restorani — 'WE went there'
        (amakisi aytilmagan)

  Gap ikkalasini ChALKAShTIRGAN.

  To'g'ri tuzatish: amakisi uni HARRODS'ga
  olib borgan, restoranga emas.


⚠ 6-BAND — IKKI XATO:

  a) Joyi noto'g'ri: Covent Garden emas,
     HYDE PARK.
  b) Xatda aniq aytilgan: 'I HAVEN'T BEEN to
     Covent Garden YET.'


TUZATISh USULI — QOLIP:

  'No, ... isn't/doesn't ... . ... is/does
   ... .'

  Masalan:
     'No, the weather isn't rainy. It's warm
      and sunny.'
     'No, Ann didn't buy lots of things. She
      didn't buy anything.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  rainy       = yomg'irli
  terrible    = dahshatli
  lots of     = ko'p
  to correct  = to'g'rilamoq
  a statement = bayonot, gap

points.en: 1  ✗ The weather in London is rainy.  →  ✓ The weather in London is warm and sunny.
points.uz: 1 ✗ Londonda havo yomg'irli. → ✓ Londonda havo iliq va quyoshli.
points.noteUz:
DALIL: 'The weather IS WARM AND SUNNY.'
(xatning birinchi gapi)

points.en: 2  ✗ Ann is having a terrible time.  →  ✓ Ann is having a wonderful time.
points.uz: 2 ✗ Ann dahshatli vaqt o'tkazyapti. → ✓ Ann ajoyib vaqt o'tkazyapti.
points.noteUz:
DALIL: 'I am having A WONDERFUL TIME.'

terrible (dahshatli) ↔ wonderful (ajoyib).

points.en: 3  ✗ Ann hasn't visited Buckingham Palace yet.  →  ✓ Ann has already visited Buckingham Palace. She visited it on Friday.
points.uz: 3 ✗ Ann hali Bukingem saroyiga bormagan. → ✓ Ann allaqachon borgan. U juma kuni borgan.
points.noteUz:
⚠ ENG NOZIK BAND!

DALIL: 'I have ALREADY visited Buckingham
Palace. We visited it ON FRIDAY.'

'hasn't ... YET' va 'has ALREADY ...' — ZID.
Tuzatishda 'yet' ni 'already' ga almashtiring.

points.en: 4  ✗ Ann bought lots of things in Harrods.  →  ✓ Ann didn't buy anything in Harrods.
points.uz: 4 ✗ Ann Harrods'da ko'p narsa sotib oldi. → ✓ Ann Harrods'da hech narsa sotib olmadi.
points.noteUz:
DALIL: 'but I DIDN'T BUY ANYTHING.'

'anything' — inkorda ishlatiladi.

points.en: 5  ✗ Ann's uncle took her to a traditional restaurant.  →  ✓ Ann's uncle took her to Harrods. She went to an Indian restaurant, but not with her uncle.
points.uz: 5 ✗ Ann amakisi uni an'anaviy restoranga olib bordi. → ✓ Amakisi uni Harrods'ga olib bordi. Hind restoraniga esa boshqalar bilan bordi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ ENG PUXTA O'QISH KERAK!

DALIL: 'My uncle took me THERE [= to
HARRODS] yesterday.'
Restoran haqida esa: 'WE went there last
night' — amakisi aytilmagan.

Gap ikki joyni CHALKASHTIRGAN.

points.en: 6  ✗ Ann and her uncle are going to Covent Garden tomorrow.  →  ✓ Ann and her uncle are going to Hyde Park tomorrow. She hasn't been to Covent Garden yet.
points.uz: 6 ✗ Ann va amakisi ertaga Kovent Gardenga borishadi. → ✓ Ular ertaga Hayd Parkka borishadi. Ann hali Kovent Gardenga bormagan.
points.noteUz:
⚠ IKKI XATO:
a) DALIL: 'We are going to HYDE PARK
   tomorrow.'
b) DALIL: 'I HAVEN'T BEEN to Covent Garden
   or Piccadilly Circus YET.'

points.en: 7  ✗ Ann is returning home on 20th August.  →  ✓ Ann is returning home on 15th June.
points.uz: 7 ✗ Ann 20-avgustda uyga qaytadi. → ✓ Ann 15-iyunda uyga qaytadi.
points.noteUz:
DALIL: 'I am returning home on 15TH JUNE.'

Xatning boshida sana yo'q, lekin oxirida
aniq aytilgan.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the prompts below to complete Helen's letter to her friend, Pam. (15 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi ishoralardan foydalanib, Helenning dugonasi Pamga yozgan xatini to'ldiring. (15 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
XAT SARLAVHASI (kitobda berilgan):
  14, Scott Road
  Romley
  8th June, ...

  Dear Pam,
  ...
  Love,
  Helen


TO'LIQ XAT — TO'G'RI JAVOB:

──────────────────────────────────────────
  14, Scott Road
  Romley
  8th June, ...

  Dear Pam,

  Guess what! I AM GOING on holiday with my
  friend Claire for a whole month!

  We ARE FLYING to Spain on 20th June.
  Claire and I LOVE climbing, so we ARE
  STAYING at a hotel near the Pyrenees. We
  WANT to travel around Spain too, so we ARE
  HIRING a car.

  We ARE COMING BACK from our holidays on
  21st July and I HAVE GOT lots of plans for
  the autumn. First, I AM GOING TO START
  exercising because I WANT TO LOSE some
  weight. I AM GOING TO JOIN an art class and
  LEARN HOW TO PAINT, too.

  Oh! I NEARLY FORGOT! On 30th July I AM
  HAVING a party at my house. Please TRY TO
  COME. You CAN SPEND the night here.

  Well, THAT IS all for now. HOPE TO SEE you
  soon.

  Love,
  Helen
──────────────────────────────────────────


TARJIMASI:

  Aziz Pam,

  Bilasanmi nima! Men dugonam Kler bilan
  butun bir oyga ta'tilga chiqyapman!

  20-iyunda Ispaniyaga uchamiz. Kler bilan
  ikkalamiz tog'ga chiqishni yaxshi ko'ramiz,
  shuning uchun Pireney tog'lari yaqinidagi
  mehmonxonada turamiz. Ispaniya bo'ylab ham
  sayohat qilmoqchimiz, shuning uchun mashina
  ijaraga olamiz.

  21-iyulda ta'tildan qaytamiz va kuz uchun
  ko'p rejalarim bor. Avvalo, sport bilan
  shug'ullana boshlayman, chunki biroz vazn
  tashlamoqchiman. Rassomchilik to'garagiga
  ham yoziladigan va rasm chizishni
  o'rganaman.

  Voy! Deyarli unutayozdim! 30-iyulda uyimda
  bazm o'tkazaman. Iltimos, kelishga harakat
  qil. Kechasi shu yerda qolsang bo'ladi.

  Xo'sh, hozircha shu. Tez orada ko'rishamiz
  degan umiddaman.

  Mehr bilan,
  Helen


HAR PARAGRAF UChUN QAYSI ZAMON:

 1-PARAGRAF — YANGILIK e'lon qilish:
    'I AM GOING on holiday'
    → Present Continuous (rejalashtirilgan
      kelajak, sana belgilangan)

 2-PARAGRAF — ANIQ REJALAR (sanalar bor):
    'We ARE FLYING ... on 20th June'
    'we ARE STAYING at a hotel'
    'we ARE HIRING a car'
    → Present Continuous

    ⚠ LEKIN doimiy holat — Present Simple:
       'Claire and I LOVE climbing'
       'We WANT to travel'

 3-PARAGRAF — NIYATLAR (sana yo'q):
    'I AM GOING TO START exercising'
    'I AM GOING TO JOIN an art class'
    → BE GOING TO (niyat, reja)

    ⚠ 'We ARE COMING BACK ... on 21st July'
    — sana bor → Present Continuous

 4-PARAGRAF:
    'I NEARLY FORGOT!' → Past Simple
    'On 30th July I AM HAVING a party'
    → Present Continuous (sana bor)
    'You CAN SPEND the night' → can (ruxsat)

 5-PARAGRAF — YAKUN:
    'That IS all for now.'
    'HOPE TO SEE you soon.'


⚠ UNIT 13 NING ASOSIY QOIDASI:

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS — ANIQ VAQT/SANA
     belgilangan reja
     'We are flying ON 20TH JUNE.'

  BE GOING TO — NIYAT, sana hali yo'q
     'I am going to start exercising.'

  WILL — bashorat, va'da, o'sha zahotgi
     qaror


⚠ IShORALARNI GAPGA AYLANTIRISh QOIDALARI:

  1) Kerakli SO'ZLARNI qo'shing:
     artikllar (a, an, the), predloglar (on,
     at, to, for), egalik olmoshlari (my,
     our)

     'I/go/on holiday/with/friend/Claire'
     → 'I am going on holiday with MY friend
        Claire'

  2) FE'LNI to'g'ri zamonga qo'ying.

  3) BOG'LOVChILARNI saqlang:
     'so' (shuning uchun), 'because' (chunki),
     'and' (va), 'too' (ham)

  4) BOSh HARF va TINISh belgilarini
     qo'shing.


XAT YOZISh QOIDALARI (do'stona xat):

  MANZIL — o'ng yuqorida
  SANA — manzil ostida
  MUROJAAT — 'Dear Pam,' (VERGUL bilan)
  YAKUN — 'Love,' / 'Best wishes,' (do'stona)
  IMZO — ism

  ⚠ Rasmiy xatda: 'Dear Mr Smith,' ...
    'Yours sincerely,'


DIQQAT — 'GUESS WHAT!':
  'Guess what!' = Bilasanmi nima!
  Yangilikni e'lon qilishdan oldingi ibora.


DIQQAT — 'I NEARLY FORGOT!':
  'nearly' = deyarli
  'I nearly forgot!' = Deyarli unutayozdim!

  forget → FORGOT → forgotten


DIQQAT — 'TO HIRE A CAR':
  'to hire a car' = mashina ijaraga olmoq
  (AmE: 'to rent a car')


DIQQAT — 'TO LOSE WEIGHT':
  'to lose weight' = vazn tashlamoq
  'to put on weight' = vazn olmoq

  lose → LOST → lost


DIQQAT — 'LEARN HOW TO PAINT':
  'learn HOW TO do something' = qilishni
  o'rganmoq


DIQQAT — 'TRY TO COME':
  'try TO do' = qilishga harakat qilmoq
  'try DOING' = sinab ko'rmoq (boshqa ma'no)


DIQQAT — 'SPEND THE NIGHT':
  'to spend the night' = tunab qolmoq


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Guess what!  = Bilasanmi nima!
  a whole month = butun bir oy
  the Pyrenees = Pireney tog'lari
  climbing     = tog'ga chiqish
  to hire a car = mashina ijaraga olmoq
  to travel around = bo'ylab sayohat qilmoq
  autumn       = kuz
  to exercise  = sport bilan shug'ullanmoq
  to lose weight = vazn tashlamoq
  an art class = rassomchilik to'garagi
  to paint     = rasm chizmoq
  nearly       = deyarli
  to forget    = unutmoq
  to have a party = bazm o'tkazmoq
  to spend the night = tunab qolmoq
  That's all for now = hozircha shu
  Hope to see you soon = tez orada
                 ko'rishamiz degan umiddaman

points.en: Para 1:  Guess what! I am going on holiday with my friend Claire for a whole month!
points.uz: 1-paragraf: Bilasanmi nima! Men dugonam Kler bilan butun bir oyga ta'tilga chiqyapman!
points.noteUz:
ISHORA: I/go/on holiday/with/friend/Claire/
whole month!

QO'SHILDI: am ...ing, MY, FOR A.

'AM GOING' — rejalashtirilgan kelajak
(Present Continuous).
'go ON holiday' — turg'un ibora.

points.en: Para 2:  We are flying to Spain on 20th June. Claire and I love climbing, so we are staying at a hotel near the Pyrenees. We want to travel around Spain too, so we are hiring a car.
points.uz: 2-paragraf: 20-iyunda Ispaniyaga uchamiz. Kler bilan ikkalamiz tog'ga chiqishni yaxshi ko'ramiz, shuning uchun Pireney tog'lari yaqinidagi mehmonxonada turamiz. Ispaniya bo'ylab ham sayohat qilmoqchimiz, shuning uchun mashina ijaraga olamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ IKKI XIL ZAMON BIR PARAGRAFDA:

REJA (sana bor) → Present Continuous:
  'are FLYING on 20th June'
  'are STAYING at a hotel'
  'are HIRING a car'

DOIMIY holat → Present Simple:
  'Claire and I LOVE climbing'
  'We WANT to travel'

'to hire a car' = mashina ijaraga olmoq.

points.en: Para 3:  We are coming back from our holidays on 21st July and I have got lots of plans for the autumn. First, I am going to start exercising because I want to lose some weight. I am going to join an art class and learn how to paint, too.
points.uz: 3-paragraf: 21-iyulda ta'tildan qaytamiz va kuz uchun ko'p rejalarim bor. Avvalo, sport bilan shug'ullana boshlayman, chunki biroz vazn tashlamoqchiman. Rassomchilik to'garagiga ham yoziladigan va rasm chizishni o'rganaman.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'BE GOING TO' — NIYAT (aniq sana YO'Q):
  'am GOING TO START exercising'
  'am GOING TO JOIN an art class'

Lekin 'are COMING BACK on 21st July' —
SANA bor → Present Continuous.

'to lose weight' = vazn tashlamoq.
'learn HOW TO paint' — 'how to' qurilmasi.

points.en: Para 4:  Oh! I nearly forgot! On 30th July I am having a party at my house. Please try to come. You can spend the night here.
points.uz: 4-paragraf: Voy! Deyarli unutayozdim! 30-iyulda uyimda bazm o'tkazaman. Iltimos, kelishga harakat qil. Kechasi shu yerda qolsang bo'ladi.
points.noteUz:
'I nearly FORGOT!' — Past Simple
(forget → FORGOT).

'On 30th July I AM HAVING a party' — sana
bor → Present Continuous.

'try TO come' (harakat qilmoq);
'try DOING' — sinab ko'rmoq (boshqa ma'no).

'CAN spend' — ruxsat berish.

points.en: Para 5:  Well, that is all for now. Hope to see you soon.
points.uz: 5-paragraf: Xo'sh, hozircha shu. Tez orada ko'rishamiz degan umiddaman.
points.noteUz:
Do'stona xatning turg'un yakuni:
  'That's all for now.'
  'Hope to see you soon.'
  'Write back soon.'

Keyin: 'Love, Helen' (do'stona imzo).

points.en: Xat tuzilishi:  14, Scott Road / Romley / 8th June, ... — Dear Pam, — ... — Love, Helen
points.uz: Manzil va sana yuqorida; 'Dear Pam,' murojaat; 'Love, Helen' yakun.
points.noteUz:
DO'STONA XAT QOIDALARI:
  MANZIL — o'ng yuqorida
  SANA — manzil ostida
  MUROJAAT — 'Dear Pam,' (VERGUL bilan)
  YAKUN — 'Love,' / 'Best wishes,'

RASMIY xatda: 'Dear Mr Smith,' ...
'Yours sincerely,'

groups.ruleUz: ⚠ 10-MASHQNING ASOSIY NAMUNASI: Present Perfect → Past Simple
groups.explanationUz: Avval NATIJA (vaqtsiz), keyin TAFSILOT (vaqt bilan). Bu — Unit 15 ning kaliti.

items.base: I HAVE ALREADY VISITED Buckingham Palace.
I HAVE ALSO BEEN to Harrods.
items.derived: My uncle TOOK me there YESTERDAY.

items.base: I HAVE EATEN at an Indian restaurant.
I haven't BEEN to Covent Garden yet.
yesterday / last night / on Friday / ago

patterns.exampleEn: I have already visited Buckingham Palace. We visited it on Friday.
patterns.exampleUz: Bukingem saroyiga allaqachon borganman. Unga juma kuni bordik.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ TESTNING ASOSIY NAMUNASI:
avval NATIJA (vaqtsiz → Present Perfect),
keyin TAFSILOT (vaqt bilan → Past Simple).

patterns.formula: I HAVE BEEN to [joy].   /   I HAVEN'T BEEN to [joy] YET.
patterns.exampleEn: I have also been to Harrods. I haven't been to Covent Garden yet.
patterns.exampleUz: Harrods'ga ham borib keldim. Hali Kovent Gardenga bormadim.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'BEEN' = borib KELDI (hozir u yerda emas);
'GONE' = ketdi, HALI u yerda.

patterns.formula: HAS + [ega] + [V3] ... YET?  —  Yes, ... . He HAS JUST + [V3].
patterns.exampleEn: Has Peter washed the car yet? — Yes, he has. He's just finished.
patterns.exampleUz: Piter mashinani yuvdimi? — Ha. U hozirgina tugatdi.
patterns.explanationUz:
YET — savol/inkor, GAP OXIRIDA;
JUST — tasdiq, HAVE va V3 ORASIDA.

patterns.formula: What are you doing tonight?  —  Would you like to go?  —  That would be great!
patterns.exampleEn: What are you doing tonight? ... Would you like to go? — Yes, that would be great!
patterns.exampleUz: Bugun kechqurun nima qilyapsan? ... Borishni xohlaysanmi? — Ha, zo'r bo'lardi!
patterns.explanationUz:
Taklif qilish dialogi.
'What are you doing tonight?' — Present
Continuous kelajak ma'nosida.

patterns.formula: You SHOULD + [fe'l].  /  CAN I + [fe'l]?  /  You MUSTN'T + [fe'l].
patterns.exampleEn: You should see a doctor. Can I have a glass of milk? You mustn't feed the animals.
patterns.exampleUz: Shifokorga ko'rin. Bir stakan sut ichsam bo'ladimi? Hayvonlarni boqma.

patterns.formula: I AM GOING TO + [fe'l]   ↔   I AM + [fe'l]ING + ON [sana].
patterns.exampleEn: I am going to start exercising. I am having a party on 30th July.
patterns.exampleUz: Sport bilan shug'ullana boshlayman. 30-iyulda bazm o'tkazaman.
